en: A black‑and‑white image showing a river scene with a long steam-powered passenger vessel named "KEELIN" (or similar) in profile at mid‑distance. The boat is full of people and emits smoke from a central funnel as it moves along a tree‑lined bank. On the shore are simple riverside structures and another smaller steam vessel. In the foreground, several wooden rowboats and small craft are moored, some with supplies or equipment onboard, and a few ducks are visible on the water. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century tourist or excursion steamer on a calm inland waterway.
